verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted URL-to-markdown and search API, and such a service could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only raw curl calls against r.jina.ai/s.jina.ai, a prebuilt Docker image, a web code builder and an official MCP server. None of these is a dedicated official command-line tool, so there is no evidence of an official CLI.
